name: Pharmco Industries Inc
old_description: Locally owned and operated, Pharmco is a full-service feed, seed, animal health, farming and ranching equipment provider serving the Midwest. When you need expert advice, products, and services that’ll make your operation successful, look to Pharmco.
about:
Pharmco Industries Inc operates from its headquarters in Chamberlain, South Dakota, with additional locations in Platte, Winner, and Kimball. The company describes itself as locally owned and operated, though a founding year and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The business functions as a full-service agricultural supplier, offering feed, seed, animal health products, and farming and ranching equipment. Its service portfolio includes ration formulation, nutrition advice, management recommendations, alternative feed sourcing, byproduct comparison and supplement guidance, feedlot profitability analysis, cattle record-keeping with monthly tracking and closeout billing, regular visual cattle inspections, and brokered connections for feedstuffs and livestock. The company does not manufacture these products but sources them from established brands.

Pharmco serves crop and livestock producers across the Midwest, including custom feed yards, feedlot operators, and row-crop farmers. Its customer base spans the livestock, seed, and broader agricultural sectors, with the team drawing on experience in livestock and seed industries to provide tailored recommendations.

The company emphasizes its local ownership and territory-specific services as differentiators, positioning its knowledgeable team and relationships with trusted product suppliers as the foundation for helping customers grow their operations.
